name: Laukkanen-Nordgren (Finland), WBF standard card, 2025 European Online Women's Teams

provenance.source: WBF standard card of Annu Laukkanen and Maria Nordgren, Finland, 2025 European Online Women's Teams: https://realbridge.online/assets/System%20Cards/European%20Online%20Women%27s%20Teams%202025%20-%20System%20Cards/FINLAND%20KIPA/AnnuLaukkanenMariaNordgren.pdf
provenance.format: wbf-card (WBF Standard Card template; suit symbols partly lost in its text layer)
provenance.reader: bill (Gen 9), 12 November 2026, by the intake procedure in docs/gen9/card-intake.md

medium: open.three_level (six cards; the card lists 3C to 3S as six-card preempts)
comp.vs_nt (Multi-Landy: 2D both majors 4-4+, 2H/2S five and a four-card minor, 2C one major, read as a six-card major)
low: open.minor (3+ cards; which minor with 3-3 and 4-4 not stated: defaults)
open.four_level (4C and 4D are Namyats-style; only the major preempt default kept)
carding (1st, 3rd or 5th leads; signals: see carding_read)

carding_read.when: 12 November 2026 (bill), for the situation fields of G9-D6
low: signal_on_partner_lead attitude, attitude upside_down, count upside_down: row 1 read as attitude with low encouraging, row 2 as count with low-high even, row 3 suit preference, all in the partner's-lead column
first_discard odd_even: "o/e" read as the discarding cell of row 1, "Same" as the declarer's-lead cell; it could also be one cell, "same odd/even", on declarer's lead
not_placed: declarer's lead "Same" (as on partner's lead, attitude first: not a value of signal_on_declarer_lead, so left out)
no-trump: count first except attitude on an ace lead

defaulted: resp.two_over_one ('2 over 1 response promises rebid': not game force; the default gf was kept, to be confirmed)
not_placed: 1M responses: 3C = 10-11 with three-card support, 3D = 8-9 with four (Bergen-style raises), not compiled
Drury in third and fourth seat
2D strong: 2H neutral (the card's '2C neutral' is read as the next step); positives need a good suit
2NT: Puppet Stayman (3S = five spades and four hearts)
responsive doubles through 4H after a takeout double, through 4S after an overcall
Lebensohl after a two-level overcall of 1NT and over weak twos
RKCB void showing (5NT odd + void, 6x even + void)
